bib.title: Prediction of rupture risk in abdominal aortic aneurysm during observation: wall stress versus diameter

supports.our_claim: Abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) rupture risk is governed by biomechanical wall stress, and peak wall stress is a better predictor of rupture than maximum diameter alone.
supports.quote: With proportional hazards analysis, peak wall stress (relative risk, 25x) and gender (relative risk, 3x) were the only significant independent predictors of rupture. For AAAs under observation, peak AAA wall stress seems superior to diameter in differentiating patients who will experience catastrophic outcome.

bib.title: In vivo analysis of mechanical wall stress and abdominal aortic aneurysm rupture risk

supports.our_claim: Abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) rupture risk is governed by biomechanical wall stress, and peak wall stress is a better predictor of rupture than maximum diameter alone.
supports.quote: Peak wall stresses calculated in vivo for AAAs near the time of rupture were significantly higher than peak stresses for electively repaired AAAs, even when matched for maximal diameter.
